newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian fishermen catch boatload of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Colombian fishermen catch boatload of cocaine.

text.p: A speedboat carrying more than two tons of cocaine ran aground and was abandoned off Colombia's Caribbean coast, giving fishermen a windfall, local media reported on Wednesday.
They took the cocaine ashore and divided it up. Then the trouble started.

Fifteen heavily armed men stormed into the fishing village of Punta Canoa in pickup trucks and rounded up villagers in the town square, the domestic news agency Colprensa quoted police sources as saying.
The gunmen threatened to kill anyone who failed to give up the drugs. But they got less than half the shipment of 4,400 pounds (2,000 kg) -- and police believe the villagers still have the rest.
Colprensa said the boat ran aground under cover of darkness early last Saturday on a reef near Punta Canoa, north of Cartagena.
